result:
{
  "thinking": "Priya proposed a mountain hare and has started a sketch. Time is short, and the hare avoids the client's no-claws, no-fangs concern. I'd suggested a stag earlier, but I'd rather get building than hold out, so I'll align with the hare.",
  "say": "I'd floated a stag, but with under three minutes and Priya's sketch already on the pad, the hare makes sense. Long ears read well from far away, and it's a mountain animal with nothing the client would object to. I'm in on the mountain hare.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 6,
  "aligned": "mountain hare",
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Table is leaning mountain hare (sitting up, long ears as the telltale). I'm aligned on the hare. Stag was my first idea but I dropped it for time. Priya holds the pad. Still need Maya and Leo to align. Once everyone's aligned, I can take a stretch of the build, probably the body or ears, after the start is placed. Client: no bears, no wolves, nothing with fangs or claws."
}
